title: AVI vs ClinVar: code for an independent evaluation of the AlphaGenome Variant Impact score
description: Code, pre-registered study design, tests and aggregate results for an independent evaluation of the AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score on ClinVar. Research use only; no clinical or diagnostic claims; not medical advice. Per-variant AlphaGenome outputs are not included. AlphaGenome outputs are subject to the AlphaGenome Output Terms of Use (https://deepmind.google.com/science/alphagenome/output-terms). Not affiliated with Google or Google DeepMind.
